planets.name: TOI-5624 e
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5624 with a 21.5-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-5624 e was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 5 planets known around TOI-5624. Its orbit and size follow Bonfanti et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.

quotes.title: TOI-5624 e
quotes.card: TOI-5624 e is the fourth and the second largest exoplanet discovered in the TOI-5624 system, located approximately 331 light-years from Earth in the constellation Ursa Major.
quotes.introduction: The discovery of the object was officially announced by an international team of astronomers led by Andrea Bonfant in late April 2026.
